description: This file defines the DialogDispatcher class responsible for handling dialog events in the Playwright core server, including accepting and dismissing dialogs within browser contexts or pages.

classes.name: DialogDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class that manages dialog interactions, allowing acceptance or dismissal of dialogs during test automation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a DialogDispatcher instance scoped to either a page or a browser context, capturing dialog details.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a dialog with optional prompt text, reporting progress.

ctags.name: DialogDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class DialogDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Dialog, channels.DialogChannel, BrowserContextD/
